g.text: Small: lighter solid; large: darker dotted. C: open fill single front; filled multiple fronts; grey fill low contrast; square >1.5× lag drift.

g.text: Pointwise whole-seed 95% CIs. Horizontal references: ratio 1 and nominal geometry 9. D is descriptive; it does not establish a cause of erosion.

g.text: H1 uses a post hoc f < large-cell f½ domain; frozen H1 remains inconclusive. Goryachev retained in supplement only.
